scripts.build:js: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src='resources/js';const dest='public/js';if(!fs.existsSync(dest))fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(src))if(f.endsWith('.js'))fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src,f),path.join(dest,f));console.log('JS copied:',fs.readdirSync(src).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')).length,'files');"
scripts.dev: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
